functions.name: getPendingLink
functions.description: Returns the last rozelynxsync:// URL the browser handed to the extension (the observer notification can race an event-page wakeup, so the link is also parked in a slot this reads; empty string when none is pending).

events.name: onSyncLink
events.description: Fired when the browser navigates to a rozelynxsync:// magic link (typed in the URL bar, clicked from a page, or passed on the command line by the OS handler). The event carries the full URL, payload and all; the extension decrypts it and restores the state it encodes.
